description.value: ABODE is a West End Vancouver brunch destination on Robson Street, serving modern comfort classics made with local, seasonal ingredients and bold flavours. The coffee bar proudly features Salt Spring Island Coffee. A sunny street-side patio makes it a natural rest stop for cyclists exploring downtown Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces, covered) at 15m; stands (2 spaces) at 67m; stands (6 spaces) at 73m; stands (6 spaces) at 77m; stands (4 spaces) at 80m; stands (2 spaces) at 81m. Total: 30 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms ABODE is an active brunch restaurant at 1223 Robson Street, Vancouver, open 7 days a week — directly contradicting OSM's Sa/Su-only opening hours. OSM tags (diet:vegetarian=yes, diet:vegan=yes) are corroborated by website labels 'Vegetarian Friendly' and tofu-based menu items; the website also explicitly states 'we do not have a gluten free kitchen' despite offering gluten-friendly modifications. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or takeout information appears in either the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM opening_hours (Sa,Su 07:30-13:30 only) conflicts with website claim of open '7 days a week' — OSM data appears outdated.
No phone number present in OSM or visible in website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: ABODE is a legitimate, active brunch restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling corridor with vegetarian and vegan menu options; it would benefit touring cyclists as a food stop.
